description: This PHP source file defines the SSECMiddleware class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for managing Server-Side Encryption with Customer-Provided Keys (SSE-C) for Amazon S3. It simplifies the process by encoding and hashing encryption keys, ensuring secure handling of SSE-C operations.

classes.name: SSECMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that manages server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C) for AWS S3 operations, handling key encoding and MD5 hashing to facilitate secure requests.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Factory method to create a middleware instance wrapped with the specified endpoint scheme (http or https).

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with the endpoint scheme and the next handler in the middleware chain.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to process an S3 command, verifying HTTPS usage and preparing SSE-C parameters.

methods.name: prepareSseParams
methods.description: Encodes the SSE-C keys and MD5 hashes necessary for secure SSE-C operations, handling both standard and copy source requests.
